rules.description: Serves as the baseline document text color and provides a dramatic, near-black backdrop for the top hero section.
Provides stark maximum contrast for primary typography and anchors the bottom of the page with a solid dark footer.
when_to_use: Translucent overlay washes on image cards (#0000000a)

rules.description: Forms the foundational canvas of the site and shapes the interactive containers that rest on it.
when_to_use: Secondary button and search bar fills (#E5E5E0)
Primary button text and logo fill

rules.description: De-emphasizes secondary metadata and helper copy to maintain a clear, scannable typographic hierarchy.
when_to_use: Board card metadata (Pin counts and timestamps)
Form field helper text and legal disclaimers

rules.description: Outlines interactive form fields and external elements without competing visually with the text inside them.
